notes.notes:
An issue with the teleport scroll has been fixed:
Circle of light is now displayed again when the group teleports back.

A few translations into English have been corrected.

Enemy weaknesses have been adjusted.

The next update includes new areas to explore, including:

The School

notes.title: A few changes
notes.notes:
A bug was fixed: In the Falcon Forest area, after completing the quest "My Belongings", the Player could repeatedly talk to the Quest giver and get Gold and Experience each time, this is no longer possible.

A bug was fixed: The map where your Heroes, meet the evil Wizard who enchanted the beautiful city of Curvin now has an exit.

A bug was fixed: When Zura is in the Group, she now gets +200HPmax and +100MPmax when the Group drinks from the strange liquid.

A bug was fixed: The 1st main quest is now no longer repeatable.

A bug was fixed: If you have Worker 5 and 6 in the Group they are now displayed.

A bug was fixed: Laboratory Level 2 displayed the wrong Chest when opened.

A bug was fixed: In the PSA agency, the Boss was added to the Group several times by talking to the NPC's repeatedly, this is now no longer possible.

Ring of the desert for class Mage MP regeneration reduced from 3% to 2%.

Enemy Customization: [b]Flail [/b]weakness has been added to all drones.

Enemy Customization: Zombies now have weak point [b]Fire [/b]instead of [b]Ice[/b].

Enemy Customization: Adult slimes now have weak point [b]Wind [/b]instead of [b]Ice[/b].

A few texts were corrected.

notes.title: Clothing and Enemy customization!
notes.notes:
Enemy [b]weak Plant[/b] Weak point fire added EXP and gold value adjusted.
Enemy [b]Hornet[/b] Weak Point Fire added.
Enemy [b]small Jellyfish[/b] EXP and Gold adjusted.

Texts in the area Erentjorst Castle were adjusted.

The item [b]Headband of the Guild[/b] for the Assassin class now has its correct equipment slot.

notes.title: Error fixed
notes.notes: Fixed a bug, that prevented Yukina's Diary from being launched from the Shop page.

notes.title: English Language Pack, New Dungeon and new exciting Stories!
notes.notes:
Hi dear Gamers,
the update is finally ready, you can now choose [b]English[/b] as selectable Language when you start a [b]New Game[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/b6d074d3eedef087d45e6e3ceba5bb5e19142e20.jpg[/img]

[b]Starting maps[/b] were embellished.
For those brave enough to search Chapter 1, [b]3 Diaries[/b] await you, which not only contain exciting Stories, but also give important hints to a [b]Set Item[/b] as well as the [b]Key[/b] to the corresponding Chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/9f50f8087384aa215aac2e5948237a676ce6302d.png[/img]
[b]Texts[/b] were edited.
New [b]Weapons[/b] were forged.

As announced a [b]new Combat System[/b]:
Each enemy now has visible weak points (sword, axe, bow, dagger, fire, ice, light and more).
These are displayed under the enemy once you hit him with them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/b13dbb87d288d2b16625bdbaac86cf77ed8ff461.jpg[/img]
On the side of the Enemy appears a Shield with a Number e.g. If you hit the opponent "Galuna" who has a Shield of 3.
3x with sword, bow, flail and/or lightning the shield breaks and the opponent is stunned for one to two rounds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/0dc77b140275537e448451ae86fe183cdac1012e.jpg[/img]

This allows the fight to be more strategic, you can stun healers before their turn.

Healing and special abilities only possible with TP points, (no longer possible with MP) these can now be found in the Special tab.

A new (optional) [b]Dungeon[/b] has appeared.
[b]The Tower of the many Ways[/b] regularly attracts adventurers with its riches.
Watch out, this Tower has already driven many a Group of Heroes mad.
Since you can only move on the 3 floors by Teleporter, it is quite troublesome to find the right ones to loot all the Treasures, since there are over 40 in number.

The friendly Vampire, Amiero tells you all the other details in a quite interesting continuous loop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/5d1a00a096c89e63470863c72ed186e4fdeb5a63.png[/img]

A small excerpt from the Diaries mentioned above:
I Sir Fiodor Laeshire, had the order from the King himself to search for the Elves.
I was one of the most famous and best thieves in my home town of Greedyvalley.
One day the King came to our Town.
I was surprised when he asked the tavern owner about the most notorious thief.
Of course, he mentioned my name.
The King came to my House with a Chest and said to me.
If you work for me as a spy, I will not let you hang on the gallows.

The whole story of Sir Fiodor Laeshire, as well as the key to his Chest.
In which there is a magic plate Armor for Darwin, you can find in Chapter 1.

[b]Enjoy the update[/b].

notes.title: The next update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi dear gamers,
Contents of the upcoming update.
Texts have been revised.
English as selectable language for New Game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/b6d074d3eedef087d45e6e3ceba5bb5e19142e20.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/e2cbe1168966a46364ae9e5b847beff451fc88fe.jpg[/img]

A new combat system:
Each enemy now has visible weak points (sword, axe, bow, dagger, fire, ice, light and more). 
These are displayed under the enemy once you hit him with them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/b13dbb87d288d2b16625bdbaac86cf77ed8ff461.jpg[/img]
On the side of the enemy appears a shield with a number e.g. If you hit the opponent "Galuna" who has a shield of 3. 
3x with sword, bow, flail and/or lightning the shield breaks and the opponent is stunned for one to two rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/0dc77b140275537e448451ae86fe183cdac1012e.jpg[/img]

This allows the fight to be more strategic, you can stun healers before their turn.

Healing and special abilities only possible with TP points, (no longer possible with MP) these can now be found in the Special tab.

The initial maps have been revised.

English translation is finished.

At the moment a new Dungeon is built and skills up to LVL 35 are designed.
New weapons and armor are being forged.

After a few test runs the update will be released.

notes.title: The story goes on!
notes.notes:
Hi dear gamers,
it is finally time for our heroes to continue their journey.
New areas to explore, new cities, new monsters, everything an adventurer's heart desires, not to forget new equipment.
Look forward to unique cities such as [b]Nazu[/b], the most unfriendly city in the world, where the inhabitants like to treat you like dirt.
This city also has a lot to offer with tempting names like Shop: "[b]Buy or go away[/b]! Bar: "[b]Drink or get lost[/b]", invites you to a longer stay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269790/0d075e4b4b4256ff8e103f59828750f7459e204a.png[/img]

Meet new friends, forge [b]alliances[/b] with them, but watch out not everyone is friendly to you!

Playing lessons:
Length of the update about [b]3-5 hours[/b].
Total about [b]19 hours[/b].
